method: Parses the file line by line and leaves every line outside a conflict block untouched. A line that starts with seven or more < plus an optional label opens a conflict; inside it the parser collects the ours section until an optional ||||||| base line (diff3 or zdiff3) or the ======= separator, collects the base section when present, then collects the theirs section until a line that starts with seven or more >. The chosen section replaces the whole block: ours, theirs, both with ours first, both reversed, the base, or the block left as it is. Marker glyphs must start the line, so a Markdown underline of ==== outside a block stays ordinary text. Malformed input is refused with its line number rather than guessed: a missing separator, an unclosed block, a second separator, a base marker after the separator, a second base marker, a theirs marker inside the ours section and nested conflicts. Line endings are preserved, including CRLF. Everything runs in the browser with no storage, uploads or network access.

sources.title: Git merge conflict markers: <<<<<<< ours, ||||||| base in diff3 style, ======= and >>>>>>> theirs
